## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add scroll-area
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `ScrollArea.gx` | `ui/scroll-area/ScrollArea.gx` |
| `ScrollArea.fixtures.go` | `ui/scroll-area/ScrollArea.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/scroll-area/ScrollArea.gx"
package scrollarea

props {
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div class={gx.Cx("relative overflow-auto", p.Class)} tabindex="0" style={gx.Style("scrollbar-width: thin")} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</div>
```

```go title="ui/scroll-area/ScrollArea.fixtures.go"
package scrollarea

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var ScrollAreaFixtures = gx.Fixtures[ScrollAreaProps]{
	"Vertical": {Class: "h-24 w-48 rounded-md border border-border p-2", Children: gx.Text("Line one. Line two. Line three. Line four. Line five. Line six. Line seven. Line eight.")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--border`.

## Usage

```gx
<scrollarea.ScrollArea class="h-64">
  <p>Long content.</p>
</scrollarea.ScrollArea>
```

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Set a height on the area.
- Keep the scroll on one axis.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not nest two scroll areas.
- Do not use a scroll area for the whole page.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Page keys | Scroll the area when it holds focus. |
